instruction: Change the font size of the title to 16 points

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing font size of the first paragraph to 16pt. Verified by document structure - paragraph 0 is the title. Metric checks if average font size is 16pt (within 0.5pt tolerance).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: font size of title (paragraph 0) should be 16pt
Getter logic is sound: extracts paragraph 0, calculates average font size across all runs, handles edge cases (missing file, empty paragraph)
Metric logic is appropriate: compares actual vs expected (16pt) with reasonable 0.5pt tolerance
Complete coverage: all instruction requirements are verified (single requirement: font size = 16pt)
Data flow is correct: getter extracts font size → metric compares with expected value
Postconfig appropriately saves document (Ctrl+S) to ensure changes are persisted before evaluation
Expected value (16pt) semantically matches instruction requirement
Minor consideration: averaging font sizes across runs means mixed-formatted titles (e.g., part 14pt, part 18pt) could pass if average is 16pt, but this is acceptable for typical single-styled titles
